notes: scrollDeltaPx of exactly 3000 at every row count is the scroll-jump bug: selecting a row while scrolled resets scroll to 0, reproduced by an intentionally-failing assertion (TDD-first, see build plan principle 1).
editCommitMs scales ~linearly with row count (138ms -> 493ms -> 5716ms), consistent with useDataTable.ts's `rows` memo rebuilding the entire row/cell array on every edit commit.

keyboardNavP50/P95 stay flat (60-94ms) across row counts and are dominated by Playwright/CDP round-trip overhead per keypress at this scale, not by the O(n) indexOf scans identified in useDataTableKeyboardNav.ts -- that fix is validated by code inspection, not this metric.
